entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Let's get this done quickly.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your account email address?
It's vip-customer@email.com. Just tell me yes or no on the return.

Thank you. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Look, it's just not what I wanted. I've read the user manual, but the interface is confusing and it's very hard to use. Frankly, I expected more. Can I return it or not?
Understood. One moment while I check the return eligibility for you...

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our policy. It looks like your purchase was 31 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. So yes, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund.
Great. Finally. What's the next step?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.

Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Also, as a VIP member, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for the trouble. You can use that on any future VeloFit purchase.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
